279746448.description:
This lot includes seven sealed VHS-C compact video cassette tapes for camcorders. It contains five Maxell TC-30 Premium High Grade HGX-Gold tapes, one JVC SX High Energy TC-20 SX tape, and one JVC EHG Hi-Fi TC-30 tape. The Maxell tapes come in gold and black boxes, while the JVC tapes have red/black and blue/gold packaging. All tapes measure approximately 3.75 x 2.25 inches. This item appears to be new and factory sealed in original shrink wrap.
A Note About Untested Cameras:
We want to be transparent about what we know and what we don't. Unless otherwise stated above, cameras have not been tested, and any included batteries, chargers, or accessories are also untested. Since all of our merchandise is donated, the condition of these components is unknown, and we cannot assume they are functional. Rather than speculate about a camera's operation, we prefer to describe it as untested and let the photos speak for its visible condition. Please review the listing carefully and bid accordingly.

279786018.description:
Hyman Products, Inc.
Authentic Berlin Wall and Lava Rock Lot
Vintage, 1989
This commemorative set features authentic segments including a piece of the Berlin Wall, preserved following the historic events of late 1989. The lot includes the original presentation box, a velvet drawstring pouch, an informative historical booklet, and a formal Declaration of Origin document. These artifacts represent a significant turning point in 20th-century history, documenting the transition from the Cold War to German reunification.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Berlin Wall Segment
- Authentic concrete cut with visible aggregate, originated in East Germany
2.
Lava Rock Piece
- Naturally textured specimen as identified in collection records
3.
Documentation
- Original 1989 Declaration of Origin and historical booklet
4.
Presentation Materials
- Original Hyman Products box and burgundy velvet drawstring pouch
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. Rock specimens are intact with natural textures. Documentation and booklet are well-preserved with minor age-toning. The original cardboard box shows light shelf wear and a partial surface tear near the barcode area. Velvet pouch is clean and functional.
THANK YOU FOR YOUR PURCHASE!
If you’re happy and you know it, please leave a 5-star rating! If there is a problem with your order, please contact us via Shop Goodwill before opening returns/claims. We strive to return all messages within one business day.
Please click the shipping estimate link in the listing to get the shipping costs directly from FedEx.  There will be no discounts or price changes after an auction has ended.
Our shipping team works hard to get out all orders as quickly as possible, that being said it may take up to 5 business days after payment for your order to ship out.  Once it ships out you will receive tracking information.
***IMPORTANT*** If your item was damaged in transit, do not throw away anything, including the box or packing materials until we have authorized you to do so. Photos will be required to file insurance claims.
Our Business hours: Monday - Friday  8:00 am to 4:00 pm Central
